title: Tightened Perturbation with Reduced Step-Size
scientific_hypothesis: Constraining thickness initialization to ±3% Gaussian perturbation around the round 2 candidate 3 median profile (mean ~278.5 nm) with 25% reduced optimizer step-size will enable finer phase-matching resolution, potentially closing the remaining 0.0032 headroom to target score 1.0 without triggering boundary reflections from wide asymmetric spreads.
design_principle: Modified quarter-wave thickness tuning with bounded gradient-based optimization; small perturbations around a proven baseline allow local refinement without escaping the basin of attraction of the high-performing solution.
proposed_topology: Air | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Si (12 finite layers, 6 high-index + 6 low-index alternating sequence starting with Ta2O5)
soft_objectives: maximize joint mean transmittance across 1260-1360 nm and 1530-1565 nm bands
minimize thickness variance from baseline profile
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method thickness optimization for multi-band AR coatings
Gradient-based local refinement around proven baseline reduces risk of escaping high-performance basin
expected_advantages: Finer phase-matching resolution from reduced step-size
Lower risk of boundary-triggered reflections from constrained perturbation
known_risks: May converge to local optimum if baseline is not in global basin
±3% perturbation may be too restrictive to explore new thickness combinations
execution_request_english: Optimize a 12-layer dielectric anti-reflection coating on silicon substrate with air incidence at 0 degrees, unpolarized light. Materials: alternating Ta2O5 (high-index) and SiO2 (low-index), starting with Ta2O5 adjacent to air, ending with SiO2 adjacent to silicon substrate. Wavelength bands: 1260-1360 nm and 1530-1565 nm, equal weighting. Initialize thicknesses using the round 2 candidate 3 median profile [278.37, 280.71, 225.29, 319.00, 272.38, 278.42, 236.68, 306.82, 314.54, 282.11, 84.20, 74.18] nm with ±3% Gaussian perturbation applied to each layer. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with step-size multiplier reduced by 25% compared to previous iteration. Thickness bounds: 20-400 nm per layer. Objective: maximize joint mean transmittance across both bands. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates count, tightest_margin, and final thicknesses_nm for all candidates. Canonical user controls: incidence angles 0 degrees. polarization unpolarized. wavelength intervals 1260-1360 nm, 1530-1565 nm. soft objectives: low average reflectance in 1260-1360 nm band; low average reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high reflection in the specified bands. manufacturing constraints: maximum 12 layers; individual layer thickness between 20 nm and 400 nm; materials restricted to Ta2O5 and SiO2.
revision_reason: Implemented feedback directive: constrained initialization to ±3% Gaussian perturbation around round 2 candidate 3 median profile, reduced optimizer step-size by 25% for finer phase-matching resolution. This differs from iteration_06 which used wider asymmetric spread initialization.
